scope: Schema adaptation of frozen evidence only; no new analysis or claims of completeness.

claims.Finding: Releases old Actor+0x5c0 through 3C07E0 if non-null, calls 3C06B0, stores the returned STATUS pointer into Actor+0x5c0, then stores EncodeNullable(Actor) into STATUS+0x268 if non-null. The Release observer has already returned before the later binding stores. In 3C06B0, a cache-hit path increments +0x264 at 3C07CA and returns without Init/Rebuild. Thus a five-writer inFlight counter alone does not cover the outer rebinding interval.
claims.Limitations: Bounded static claim only. No complete writer/alias census, common thread exclusion, live-game validation or complete semantic review.
